name: band skier v. 2
description: A band skier pull with the band anchored beneath the feet. Hinge slightly and sweep the arms backward toward the hips.
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and hold one end in each hand.
Soften your knees and hinge at the hips while keeping your back long.
Sweep your arms from in front of your thighs back toward your hips against the band, like a skier driving the poles.
Return the arms forward under control while keeping your trunk steady.
